question: Explain the fundamental accounting assumptions under AS 1 'Disclosure of Accounting Policies'. What are the major considerations in selecting accounting policies, and what does AS 1 require to be disclosed?

points.label: Going concern
points.description: The enterprise is assumed to continue in operation for the foreseeable future, with no intention or need to liquidate or sharply cut down its operations.
points.basis: AS 1, fundamental accounting assumptions: going concern

points.label: Consistency
points.description: Accounting policies are assumed to be applied in the same way from one period to the next.

points.label: Accrual
points.description: Revenues and costs are recognised as they are earned or incurred, not as cash is received or paid, and recorded in the periods to which they relate.

points.label: Disclosure of the assumptions
points.description: If these assumptions are followed, no separate disclosure is needed; if any of them is not followed, that fact must be disclosed.
points.basis: AS 1, disclosure of fundamental accounting assumptions

points.label: Considerations in selecting policies
points.description: Policies should be chosen so the statements give a true and fair view, guided mainly by prudence, substance over form and materiality.
points.basis: AS 1, considerations in the selection of accounting policies

points.label: Disclosure of policies and changes
points.description: All significant accounting policies should be disclosed together in one place as part of the financial statements; a change in policy with a material effect must be disclosed and its effect quantified where it can be ascertained.
points.basis: AS 1, disclosure of accounting policies and changes in them
